outcome: SARS-CoV-2 RNA detection in nasopharyngeal swabs of pregnant women and neonates
SARS-CoV-2 RNA detection in amniotic fluid
cohort: 91 pregnant women in labor or with an indication for induction of labor, with COVID-19
finding: The study suggests a low risk of vertical transmission of COVID-19 and favorable perinatal outcomes due to adequate preventative strategies.
